title: Polizeiliche Maßnahmen wegen des Verdachts der Arzneimittelkriminalität

extraction.summaryEn: Police executed a search warrant at a property in Naunynstraße over suspected illegal trade in prescription medicines, finding medicines, narcotics, data carriers and cash. About 140 people gathered in a protest, with verbal protests and an attempt to open a screen; one person was given a police exclusion order and nobody was hurt.
